_comment: Pipeline policy. Copy to $PIPELINE_HOME/config.json and edit. Missing keys fall back to this file. Applicant FACTS (name, education, work authorization answers) live in profile.json, not here.

mail._comment: IMAP mailboxes, searched in order. Each entry names the .env keys holding the address and an app-specific secret. The first one is where job-list emails, ATS codes and confirmations arrive.

swelist._comment: Daily job-list email source (SWE List / Simplify digest). Posting links point at simplify.jobs/p/<id>.
swelist.subject: New Internships Posted Today

eligibility._comment: Deterministic prescreen rules applied to the feed's structured fields. Never drop on an unstated value.

ineligible_companies.example corp: reason this company is excluded company-wide

roles._comment: Title-based role filters used by role-tier.py and next-batch.js.

caps._comment: per_company_submitted: hard cap on SUBMITTED applications per company across all runs (company-cap.py). per_run_default/overrides: how many roles per company role-tier.py keeps in one batch.

queue._comment: held_companies: never handed to an applier (e.g. companies you apply to yourself). top_list_expiry_days: how long a digest's top-N list holds companies back when hold_top_list is true.

apply._comment: Applier behaviour. The submit gate itself is the AUTOSUBMIT file under PIPELINE_HOME (see autosubmit.js), not this config.

tailor._comment: Résumé tailoring (tailor/tailor.py). resume_repo is a git repo holding resume.tex, skills.tex, skills-bank.json and optionally experience-bank.json. llm_cmd receives the prompt on stdin and must print JSON {"result": "..."} (the default is the Claude Code CLI). add_unlisted_jd_skills=false means only skills in YOUR skills bank are ever placed on the résumé.

browser._comment: Isolated, HEADED Chrome per applier (bin/pipeline-chrome). Instance N listens on base_cdp_port+N.

notify._comment: Shell command that receives operator messages on stdin (Slack/Discord webhook script, mail, ...). Empty = print to stderr. NOTIFY_CMD in .env overrides.
